Sixteenth-Century Hebrew Bible

As part of the humanist educational movement
of 
ad fontes
 (to the source)
European theologians and scholars began to look at the Hebrew
text of the Bible. What types of questions and problems might
arise from going beyond the standard and accepted text?

Source: Hebreaica Biblia. 2 vols. Basel: Johann Bebel for Michael
Isingrin and Heinrich Petri, 1534-35. In 
The Reformation of
the Bible. the Bible of the Reformation
, Jaroslav Pelikan.
.Catalog of the Exhibition by Valerie R. Hotchkiss and Dadvid
Price (Yale UP, 19976), p.107.
